Encounter.Name: Protection Money
Encounter.DescriptionText: While your colonies keep growing, a familiar signal comes in. It is the Orion Syndicate, whom you have met before:

Message.Text:
Dearest SING friends,
We told you that we would be in touch when we needed something. Well, here we are.
Your empire is growing nicely. All those new colonies and so many little freighters, flying between the stars like loyal bees. It would be a tragedy if anything happened to them.
So here is our proposal. You pay the Orion Syndicate MONEY credits now, and we promise a certain level of protection for your SING ships. If you decline, well, we cannot make any promises.
With warmest regards, Harcourt Fenton Mudd, Independent Trader and Gentleman (acting on behalf of the Orion Syndicate)
Wonderful news! We will let you know when we have finished drinking our way through your money. Until then, sleep safe.
Now that is disappointing, and here we were becoming such good friends. It will be a pleasure to open up your freighters.
You do not have the credits? That is not our problem. We will take our payment from your freighters instead.
